chunks: Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Imran al-Daqqaq (may Allah have mercy on him) said: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub said: Ali ibn Ibrahim said, on the authority of Muhammad ibn 'Isa, on the authority of Yunus ibn 'Abd al-Rahman, on the authority of Malik al-Juhani, that he heard Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) say:
If people knew what reward there is in speaking about the Appearance (Al-Bada'), they would never cease speaking about it.

key_terms.الْقَوْلِ بِالْبَدَاءِ: Speaking about the doctrine of Al-Bada' (Divine Appearance)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for speaking about Al-Bada' according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq uses this hadith to emphasize the high spiritual status of Al-Bada' in Shia theology, framing it not as a change in God's knowledge but as a merciful manifestation of the divine will to guide humanity. The immense reward mentioned underscores its role in resolving apparent contradictions in prophetic narratives and affirming God's absolute sovereignty over unfolding events. This concept serves as a key theological tool for Shia scholars to explain how divine decree adapts to human actions and circumstances.
